alt: Real ChatGPT /mistakelog execution: fast prompt entry, sending, accelerated generation and normal-speed widget use.
caption: New temporary chat → PDF → shortcut → generation → extended widget use
prompt: /mistakelog Using only the attached chapter, build an interactive mistake log for three misconceptions about training, inference and context. Include corrections, review controls and progress. Answer in English.
setupPrompt: Use the attached chapter as the only source for the next activity. Please wait for my next request.

phases.name: upload
phases.caption: Open a new temporary chat and upload the chapter PDF.

phases.name: setup-generation
phases.caption: ChatGPT reads the uploaded chapter · accelerated.

phases.name: typing
phases.caption: Write the shortcut request as the second message.

phases.name: send
phases.caption: Send the shortcut as the second message.

phases.name: widget
phases.caption: Inspect the generated widget before using its controls.

phases.name: usage
phases.caption: Use the widget at normal speed.

actions.label: Write why a definition added to a prompt changes context rather than weights.
Reveal the correction grounded in the uploaded chapter.
Answer the self-check by choosing information available to inference.
Mark the corrected misconception Understood after meeting the requirements.
Move to the next misconception in the log.
Write a partial explanation for the second misconception.
Reveal the chapter correction about fixed parameters during inference.
Choose the generated-answer option to inspect an unsuccessful self-check.
Mark this misconception for another review.
Move on to the retrieval misconception.
Correct the claim that retrieval updates weights and guarantees correctness.
Reveal the chapter correction about RAG and reliability.
Choose external passages available in context in the self-check.
Inspect the totals: all three reviewed, with one still needing practice.
Reopen Mistake 2 directly to revisit the stored difficult case.

deliveryNormalization.method: Aspect-preserving Lanczos downsample from 1664x1040 to 1440x900. H.264 CRF14; original 60 fps cadence and duration preserved. Native media retained in the ignored pre-pull review archive.
